conclusion: New primary management testimony makes the wafer-side ramp more concrete, but does not establish a finished-CPU quantity bridge or justify increasing the forecast. No new numerical forecast cut is uniquely identified either. The useful change is a quantified production plan plus explicit package/mix conversion tests, not a claimed investment edge.

bounded_bridge.headline: With assumed flat H1 CPU revenue, H2 needs $9.211844B/quarter: +41.16% revenue. That requires +41.16% units at flat H2/H1 ASP, +28.33% units at +10% ASP, or +17.64% units at +20% ASP.
bounded_bridge.boundary: These are combinations required by the same target, not estimated outcomes. The model annual ASP+20% cannot be assigned to H2/H1.
bounded_bridge.ireland_threshold: Only if comparable Irish good-silicon output doubles and conversion to shipped CPUs is unchanged, a 2026 associated unit share of20% covers total units+20% with legacy units flat; legacy units-20% requires33.3%. Neither share nor conversion is disclosed.
bounded_bridge.longer_term: Forecast units nearly double by2030 versus2026 (1.9824x). New evidence does not establish the2028-30 unit-growth average18.21% or continued market-share loss without a matched market forecast.

proposed_operating_policy_change.immediate: Keep the numerical forecast as an analyst case; upgrade the wafer evidence, not its certainty. Add the Ireland2027 output aim and distinguish it from the bottleneck at substrates/qualified packages.
proposed_operating_policy_change.quarterly_rule: After each2027 result, calculate required remaining CPU revenue from the unchanged annual target and actual realized revenue proxy, then test unit/ASP combinations. Reconcile reported ASP and unit changes before adjusting the annual forecast.
proposed_operating_policy_change.no_automatic_catchup: A2027 miss does not preserve the2028 absolute unit target unless the same product/customer backlog and incremental qualified capacity are independently supported.
promotion_gate: Ireland output definition and measured ramp, including relevant mix and yields
Intel-assigned substrate deliveries in the required quarters
qualified/accepted CPU shipments and realized ASP sufficient for the remaining annual hurdle
proposed_operating_policy_change.valuation_policy: No valuation change before an operating-policy choice. No price target was solved or adjusted here.
